justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/MethodAccessorFactory.java` where `Illegal` is a small nested enum with only three methods, all of which immediately throw `IllegalStateException`; it has no internal collaboration beyond `MethodDescription`, `FieldDescription`, `Implementation.SpecialMethodInvocation`, `AccessType`, and `Visibility`. Fan-in is also low: the only observed references are one production call site in `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/inline/MethodRebaseResolver.java:538` and two test classes, `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/MethodAccessorFactoryIllegalTest.java:23-33` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/auxiliary/PrivilegedMemberLookupActionTest.java:59`, which is not enough evidence for hub-like modularization.
